obligations.text: The office of the Chancellor of the California Community Colleges and the California State University shall, and the University of California is requested to, do both of the following:

Records shall include, at minimum, the name of the individual, the date of completion, and the version of the training delivered, and shall be retained for a minimum of four years following the date of completion.
